headline.text: L3 Truffle Line ran out of coconut oil and was down *5 hours* — back online at 10:55 with 4 pallets on hold.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 flagged blue conveyor belt damage above matrices 9 & 10 as a potential foreign material risk; E&C will be needed to replace. Sollich 3 regulator sensor was damaged and then repaired in 40 minutes. Otherwise routine weekend cleaning across all lines.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had brief jams past the metal detector that cleared by midshift. ML3 recovered from a drive roller belt snap and a riser pump leak, both fixed inside 20 minutes. Environmental swab came back out of spec; first of three cleanings underway.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle Line stopped at 06:12 after running out of coconut oil — Preston and team developed a recovery protocol and restarted at 10:55, with 4 pallets on hold for Monday evaluation. ML4's TG5 fin wheels are not moving; Kavin flagged it at 06:14 with no resolution by window close. MFM and ML1 (Imperial) ran routine changeover and tempering work.

notes.text: Water leak by QA area — door seal will be replaced next week (William Lopez).
Water seeping at grinding emergency door during rain; seals scheduled for replacement Monday.
Grey Boscan ran MFM with Truffle Line employees while TL was down for the coconut oil issue.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 C19 belt sensor regulator damaged
resolved.summary: Regulator for the sensor on the C19 belt is damaged; maintenance looking for spare parts.
resolved.resolution: Repaired by 12:57 — Chris Jeffs confirmed "This is repaired."

resolved.title: ML3 drive roller belt snapped
resolved.summary: One of the drive roller belts broke, stopping the line; maintenance went to get a replacement.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 16:42 — belt replaced in 12 minutes.

resolved.title: ML3 bad temper on dark chocolate
resolved.summary: Temper check came back at 0.5, then 0.2; line stopped until temper improved.
resolved.resolution: Last check 0.1 at 17:56 — "line running again" with acceptable temper.

resolved.title: ML2 jams past metal detector
resolved.summary: Line jammed repeatedly just after the metal detector; slowed to speed 10 but continued jamming every minute or two.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 13:08 — Alex Mendoza reported "the line is running a lot better."

resolved.title: ML2 sensor B298 not sensing turned product
resolved.summary: Sensor failed to detect turned product and therefore did not blow it off the line.
resolved.resolution: Fernando Flores adjusted the sensor at 18:17 and it is functioning properly (Alan Todd).

resolved.title: ML3 riser pump leak
resolved.summary: Riser pump started leaking; maintenance troubleshooting the issue.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance tightened clamp at 16:57 — "no more leaks" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: Internet outage
resolved.resolution: Back up by 12:32 — Jeffrey reported "it is working for me again."

resolved.title: ML1 sensor connector failure
resolved.summary: Inclusion hopper sensor connector is bad; maintenance notified.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 19:32 — Spencer Andrus: "Sensor is fixed."

resolved.title: ML4 video jet not printing
resolved.summary: End-pack video jet on ML4 not printing at all.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by 04:43 — Kimberly Morales confirmed "Jet printer has been fixed."

resolved.title: Truffle Line oil leak in kitchen
resolved.summary: Oil leaking in the kitchen area; maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 01:23 — "Maintenance (Kavin) fixed the leak" (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: ML4 sticker applicator missing
resolved.summary: Sticker applicator needs to be installed; single maintenance tech on shift doesn't have time.
resolved.resolution: Swapped out by 08:41 — Nathan Ruiz completed the installation.

resolved.title: ML1 Sweco found dirty during startup
resolved.summary: The Sweco was discovered to be dirty during chocolate startup and needed cleaning before proceeding.
resolved.resolution: Uninstalled, cleaned, and reinstalled by 09:58 — "The Sweco is clean and installed."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 enrober screwdrive fault
needs_attention.summary: Enrober faulted with a pop sound while running in reheat mode; operators tried restarting with same result.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance checked drive roller at 05:40, ran it forward and reverse with no fault. Unable to reproduce issue. Brandon Hernandez escalated for further investigation.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 blue belt damage above matrices 9 & 10
needs_attention.summary: Short blue conveyor belt after the white U-shaped belt is developing holes and deteriorating — potential physical contamination hazard from plastic fragments.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance cannot fix; requires E&C due to belt type. Escalated to manager. QC recommends evaluating potentially affected product per food safety procedures.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 allergen clean incomplete
needs_attention.summary: Allergen clean on jar area almost done but setup will need to be completed on 1st shift Monday; 12 absent EEs impacted cleaning progress.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning almost complete as of 07:32, but setup tasks remain for Monday 1st shift. Troy Baxter planning to come in early.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 inclusion hopper blue belt damage
needs_attention.summary: Blue belt on inclusion hopper showing wear and damage.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance will trim the belt as of 01:08 (Brandon Hernandez).

needs_attention.title: Environmental swab out of spec
needs_attention.summary: Environmental monitoring swab came back out of spec; requires three cleanings with vector swabs before and after each.
needs_attention.status: Working on exact location identification and first cleaning as of 18:24. Kathleen Gilbert directing vector swab protocol.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 fin wheels not moving
needs_attention.summary: When running film only, the fin wheels don't move at all; chain and pre-take-off motors run but fault out for speed mismatch.
needs_attention.status: Kavin checked motors, electrical cabinet, and power-cycled with no success as of 06:14. Unsure of root cause; escalated to Blake Heward, Nelson Cook, Rose Smuin, and Chad Stone.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line ran out of coconut oil
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 06:12 to change oil and discovered they had run out; ~30 minutes of production without oil in the depositor.
needs_attention.status: Line restarted at 10:55 after adding oil and mixing for 40 minutes. Organoleptic tests acceptable, 4 pallets on hold for evaluation Monday with Kathleen Gilbert. Enhanced testing protocol in place.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG 3 & 4 changeover incomplete
needs_attention.summary: King-size tooling changeover on TG 3 and 4 is only 50% complete; parts were found dirty mid-changeover and cleaning caused delay.
needs_attention.status: Peter and Efrain working on changeover as of 09:43; Efrain estimated 2 hours to completion. Needed for Monday morning startup.
